paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across values.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the variation in Macro-F1 scores in percentage as a function of the parameter . The x-axis is labeled as " value," displaying a scale ranging from "w/o" to 3 with regularly spaced tick marks at intervals of 0.1 between 0 and 1, and 1-unit intervals from 1 to 3. The y-axis indicates the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from 72.0 to 75.5, with tick labels at 0.5-unit intervals. There are two lines on the plot. The first line represents "MatDetector (ours)" and is shown in pink with circular markers and a solid line style. This line starts at approximately 72.6%, majorly fluctuates till it increases to a peak at around 75.6% at = 1, and then declines towards 72.4% at = 3. The second line stands for "ChemDataExtractor," displayed in blue with square markers and a dashed line style. It begins at around 72.6%, shows variation, peaking at approximately 73.7% at = 1, and ends just below to 72.0% at = 3.A legend positioned near the top-left of the plot defines each line by its corresponding conditional information, marker shape and color.
